title: Restricted adjunctions on $\Dctf$
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be admissible and $f:X\to Y$ separated of finite type. On the
full subcategories $\Dctf(-,\Lambda)$:

1. $f^*\dashv Rf_*$, as the restriction of the adjunction on
   $D(-_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda)$;
2. $-\otimes^{\mathbf L}K\dashv\cHom(K,-)$ for $K\in\Dctf(X,\Lambda)$, as the
   restriction of the tensor–Hom adjunction on $D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda)$;
3. $Rf_!\dashv f^!$, as the restriction of the adjunction on
   $\Loc(\Dctf(-,\Lambda))$ of [sk-prop-sf-existence].

proof.text: For fully faithful inclusions iC and iD and comparison isomorphisms for proposed restricted functors, use Mathlib Adjunction.restrictFullyFaithful. Its restrictFullyFaithful_homEquiv_apply formula, fully faithful map_preimage, homEquiv_unit, map_comp and associativity give exactly the equation in HasCompatibleRestriction. When both object properties are preserved, construct the restricted functors with ObjectProperty.lift and take identity comparison isomorphisms. These two elementary categorical steps are proved as private helpers in the item module.

Apply the pullback and direct-image preservation clauses of [det-thm-sf-ctf-stability-direct-images] to the ambient adjunction [def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull-adjunction], and use the preceding full-subcategory restriction construction. This gives clause 1, including the ambient Hom bijections.

For K in Dctf, transport the tensor-Hom adjunction [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom] along the Koszul-signed tensorLeftIsoTensorRight of the derived braided category. Its left adjoint sends M to M tensor K. The tensor clause of [det-thm-sf-ctf-stability-direct-images] and the first clause of [det-thm-sf-ctf-stability-internal-hom] prove preservation by both functors. Apply the same restriction construction for clause 2.

Let c0 be the compactification explicitly used by [det-thm-sf-ctf-stability-direct-images]. Apply [sk-prop-sf-existence] at c0 to obtain h0 and an adjunction F0 left adjoint to G on the localizing closures. Its Dctf preservation is given by the last two clauses of the direct-image stability theorem. Lift F0 and G to Dctf. For any boundary compactification c, [sk-prop-sf-existence] supplies its preservation witness h. The natural comparison of [det-sf-comp-coherence-cocycle] from c0 to c lifts to an isomorphism F0 isomorphic to Fc on the localizing closures, because their inclusions are fully faithful. Transport the ambient adjunction along this isomorphism, retaining G. Use the canonical small functors, the inverse left comparison whiskered with the Dctf inclusion, and the identity right comparison in restrictFullyFaithful. Its Hom formula proves clause 3. Compactness and quasi-separatedness of Y follow from its standing finite-type separated structure morphism to the field.
